title: Synthetic Dependency Drift Demonstration

claims.text: A controlled dependency version change coincided with a measurable output-distribution change.
The dependency change caused the measured behavioral change.

cards.summary: Synthetic decision service under controlled test.
Controlled environment with fixed test dataset and recorded configuration.
Synthetic dependency changed from v1 to v2 during controlled exercise.
Controlled dependency update at the exercise transition point.
Output distribution changed after the controlled dependency update and returned toward baseline after rollback.

verification.question: Can the observed behavioral deviation be reproduced after the controlled dependency change?
verification.independence_statement: Synthetic demonstration; independent review not yet performed.
unresolved_questions: Whether the dependency change is the sole causal mechanism.
Whether the result generalizes beyond the controlled test environment.

disclaimer: Synthetic research example. No real institution, customer, financial loss, or production incident is represented.
